reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR code on the front, which is the first proof I've seen on a supplement box; the single-serve sachets also fit my travel weeks. I'd try one box of the simple bisglycinate, not the complex.
objection: A lab report only proves what's in the capsule, not that I'll sleep better or get fewer cramps. I'll scan the QR before I order, and if the report is vague or missing, I'm out.
would_change_my_mind: A real batch report I can open and check before buying, with the lab named and the magnesium content matching the box.
